Spinderellas

Laramie, WY · Happy Jack / Tie City · Mountain bike

Women / trans / femmeBeginner friendlyNo-drop

Spinderellas is a mountain bike group ride in Laramie, WY. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:45 pm from Tie City Trailhead parking lot. Pace: recreational, no-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:45 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: recreational, no-drop. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @laramiebikenet the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Spinderellas group ride

A women's Tuesday evening mountain bike ride on the Happy Jack trails east of Laramie. Recreational pace, no-drop, fun first. Listed on Laramie BikeNet's group rides page.
